standard.summary: SDXL 专用低显存优化套件，整合 block swap、分辨率自适应、两阶段缓存等多种显存节省策略，让 8GB 显卡能够训练 SDXL LoRA。
standard.effect: 一键启用多种低显存策略组合：自动分辨率下探（防止 OOM）、智能 block swap、两阶段缓存（先缓存文本 embedding，再缓存 latent）、CPU 组件驻留等。
standard.whenToUse: 8~12GB 显卡训练 SDXL 时的综合优化套件。比手动逐一配置各个显存选项更方便。
standard.avoidWhen: 16GB+ 显卡无需使用（会降低训练速度）。单独需要某项优化时可以只开启对应的具体选项。

standard_en.summary: The SDXL-specific low-VRAM suite, which combines block swap, adaptive resolution, two-stage caching and other memory-saving strategies so that an 8GB card can train an SDXL LoRA.
standard_en.effect: One switch enables a combination of low-VRAM strategies: automatic resolution step-down (to avoid OOM), smart block swap, two-stage caching (text embeddings first, then latents), keeping components resident on CPU, and so on.
standard_en.whenToUse: The all-in-one optimisation suite for training SDXL on an 8~12GB card. More convenient than configuring each memory option by hand.
standard_en.avoidWhen: A 16GB+ card does not need it (it slows training down). If you only need one of the optimisations, enable just that specific option.

advanced.principle: 套件按优先级自动组合策略：auto_resolution_probe 先探测在当前显存下可用的最大分辨率；two_phase_cache 优先缓存文本（轻量），再缓存 latent（重量）；fixed_block_swap 固定 offload 特定 block，不动态调整；unet_backend 控制 SDXL UNet 的计算后端（影响 kernel 选择和内存布局）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 组合策略的交互效果复杂，auto_protection 开启时会自动降低分辨率（可能影响训练图像比例）；建议先了解单个选项再启用套件。

advanced_en.principle: The suite combines strategies automatically by priority: auto_resolution_probe first probes the maximum usable resolution under current VRAM; two_phase_cache caches text first (lightweight), then latents (heavy); fixed_block_swap offloads specific blocks on a fixed schedule without dynamic adjustment; unet_backend controls the SDXL UNet's compute backend (affects kernel choice and memory layout).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The interaction of combined strategies is complex; with auto_protection on, resolution is lowered automatically (possibly changing the training image aspect). Understand the individual options before enabling the suite.
